claims: Usher and Chris Brown officially announced a joint "Raymond & Brown" (R&B) stadium tour for 2026 on April 10, 2026.
Usher and Chris Brown announced the joint venture on social media on April 10, 2026.
An early listing shows a stop at Bank of America Stadium in Charlotte on July 17, 2026.
The tour name is The Raymond & Brown Tour (or "R&B Tour").
A potential stop is listed for Charlotte on July 17, 2026, on Ticketmaster.
The tour is planned for major stadiums.
As of April 10, 2026, complete ticketing information and a full city list have not been fully released.
